checks.title: Anonymous OpenAPI response satisfies every promised contract clause
preconditions: The assigned exact loopback release origin is available.
Use anonymous read-only GET; no identity, credential, cookie or authentication state is required.
reproductionSteps: Send anonymous GET /openapi.json to the registered base URL.
Assert the HTTP status, media type and every promised JSON field independently.
checks.expectedBehavior: GET /openapi.json returns HTTP200 application/json with openapi 3.0.3, info.title Widget API, and paths /v1/widgets GET summary List widgets.
checks.severityJustification: A wrong public integration contract can mislead client generation or integration development.
